mapper.select: SELECT l.line_seq, l.line_no, l.sku_seq, l.order_qty, k.sku_id, pr.product_name, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.qty_allocated - a.qty_released) FROM tb_stock_alloc a WHERE a.order_line_seq = l.line_seq), 0) AS already_allocated, s.stock_seq, s.qty_available, p.plant_seq, p.plant_id, p.plant_name, w.warehouse_id, lo.location_id FROM tb_order_line l JOIN tb_sku k ON k.sku_seq = l.sku_seq JOIN tb_product pr ON pr.product_seq = k.product_seq LEFT JOIN tb_stock s ON s.sku_seq = l.sku_seq AND s.qty_available > 0 LEFT JOIN tb_location lo ON lo.location_seq = s.location_seq AND lo.location_type = 'NORMAL' AND lo.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_seq = lo.warehouse_seq AND w.warehouse_type = 'GOOD' AND w.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN tb_plant p ON p.plant_seq = w.plant_seq AND p.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE l.order_seq = #{orderSeq} AND l.sku_seq IS NOT NULL AND l.line_status <> 'CANCELED' ORDER BY l.line_no, s.qty_available DESC, lo.location_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_stock_alloc ( stock_seq, order_line_seq, order_no, order_line_no, qty_allocated, alloc_status, allocated_at, qty_released, created_by) VALUES ( #{stockSeq}, #{orderLineSeq}, #{orderNo}, #{orderLineNo}, #{qtyAllocated}, 'ALLOCATED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0, #{createdBy})
mapper.sql: FROM tb_stock_alloc a JOIN tb_stock s ON s.stock_seq = a.stock_seq JOIN tb_location lo ON lo.location_seq = s.location_seq JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_seq = lo.warehouse_seq JOIN tb_plant p ON p.plant_seq = w.plant_seq JOIN tb_sku k ON k.sku_seq = s.sku_seq JOIN tb_product pr ON pr.product_seq = k.product_seq LEFT JOIN tb_code_group rg ON rg.code_group_id = 'REASON_SHORT' LEFT JOIN tb_code rc ON rc.code_group_seq = rg.code_group_seq AND rc.code_id = a.release_reason

a.alloc_seq, a.stock_seq, a.order_line_seq, a.order_no, a.order_line_no, a.qty_allocated, a.alloc_status, a.allocated_at, a.qty_released, a.release_reason, a.released_at, a.created_by, a.created_at, lo.location_id AS location_id, w.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, p.plant_id AS plant_id, p.plant_name AS plant_name, k.sku_id AS sku_id, k.color_code AS color_code, k.size_code AS size_code, pr.product_name AS product_name, rc.code_name AS release_reason_name

SELECT
WHERE a.order_line_seq IN ( SELECT l.line_seq FROM tb_order_line l WHERE l.order_seq = #{orderSeq}) ORDER BY a.order_line_no, a.alloc_seq

SELECT
WHERE a.order_line_seq IN ( SELECT l.line_seq FROM tb_order_line l WHERE l.order_seq = #{orderSeq}) AND a.qty_allocated > a.qty_released ORDER BY a.alloc_seq

SELECT
WHERE a.order_line_seq = #{lineSeq} AND a.qty_allocated > a.qty_released ORDER BY a.alloc_seq
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_stock_alloc SET qty_released = qty_released + #{qty}, release_reason = #{reasonCode}, released_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, alloc_status = CASE WHEN qty_released + #{qty} >= qty_allocated THEN 'RELEASED' ELSE alloc_status END, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE alloc_seq = #{allocSeq} AND qty_allocated - qty_released >= #{qty}
